title: 索尼主席谈新蜘蛛侠：首日8万块银幕，中国占多少？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You called it. I mean, we were being lit with you. I don't think anyone doubted this was going to be a big movie.
segments.zh: 你说对了。我们当时就看好它。没人怀疑这会是一部大制作。

segments.en: It's a record-setting movie. It's huge. Just talk about just sort of the process.
segments.zh: 它创下了纪录，非常火爆。聊聊制作过程吧。

segments.en: So of getting this movie out the door, and why you had so much confidence that it was going to do so well.
segments.zh: 从推出这部电影，到为何如此有信心它会大获成功。

segments.en: Well, it's my job to be confident, but I was because I'd seen the movie.
segments.zh: 自信是我的职责，但我确实有信心，因为我看了成片。

segments.en: And ultimately, I thought we did a really terrific job in the marketing campaign distributing it and be interesting for you probably to know that it was the widest release
segments.zh: 最终，我觉得我们在营销和发行上做得非常出色。你可能会感兴趣，这是发行规模最大的一次。

segments.en: in movie history. If you include China, it was on over 80,000 screens worldwide on the same day, and that's a big undertaking. But the reason I was confident
segments.zh: 在电影史上，如果算上中国，同一天全球超过8万块银幕上映，这是项大工程。但我信心的来源

segments.en: is the reason the movie's done well. And that is, it's very, very good.
segments.zh: 正是电影成功的原因，那就是它非常非常出色。

segments.en: Well, I mean, obviously there's always this concern when it comes to the superhero franchises, that after so many iterations of it, it's hard to come up with something novel and you need to
segments.zh: 当然，对于超级英雄系列，总有这种担忧：经过多次迭代，很难再出新意，你需要

segments.en: excite audiences. So when you saw the script, when you started to sort of see this mapped out here, was the sense of like, let's really try to do something different?
segments.zh: 让观众兴奋。当你看到剧本，看到初步规划时，是不是觉得要尝试些不同的东西？

segments.en: Yes. Yeah, the sense was. So you push for that. Yeah. Yeah. I mean, everybody involved did, and the credit really goes, you know, Marvelous Director,
segments.zh: 是的，确实如此。所以你们推动了这一点。是的，每个参与者都如此，功劳归于导演。

segments.en: Destin Daniel Cretten, the name which you will become much more familiar as the years go.
segments.zh: 德斯汀·丹尼尔·克里顿，这个名字未来几年你会越来越熟悉。

segments.en: I think it pushes him into the first rank of filmmakers.
segments.zh: 我认为这使他跻身一流导演之列。
